name: @woohaa3/extension-local-agent
description: 本机 Agent 生成来源扩展：Codex App Server（stdio JSON-RPC）、OpenCode Server（HTTP+SSE）、CodeBuddy Server（HTTP+ACP）；安装后默认启用。

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/frontend/index.ts --outdir dist --platform browser --entry-name frontend && node ../../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/backend/index.ts --outdir dist --platform node --entry-name backend && node ../../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/shared.ts --outdir dist --platform neutral --entry-name shared && node ../../scripts/build-package.mjs --entry src/backend/executor.ts --outdir dist --platform node --entry-name executor
